title: Roetteler 2-Query Bent-Function Hidden-Shift Carry Cancellation
claims: Under a quadratic bent carry phase (-1)^{f(u (+) s)} on 2k wires, 1-query Bernstein-Vazirani Hadamard sampling H^{otimes 2k} U_{f_s} H^{otimes 2k} |0^{2k}> produces the completely flat uniform distribution P(w) = 2^{-2k}.

Applying the dual bent phase oracle U_{f_tilde} between two Hadamard layers (Roetteler's 2-query algorithm) cancels the quadratic carry phase and recovers the exact shift s with 100% single-shot probability (P(s) = 1.0) across all 2^{2k} shifts.
